title: The saved-value editor holds its modes in three useState values (saving, typed, saveError) plus refocus and opened-on refs
evidence: widget-src/src/lib/value-cell-state.ts: closed{message, refocus} | editing{row, unit, typed, error} | blurPending | saving | savingClosed, one union with a pure transition and a table test (value-cell-state.test.ts). The typed, saving and saveError useStates and the openedOn, openedIn and refocusRef refs in ValueCell are gone; the row and unit the editor opened on are data on each open state. The cells-pins aria-invalid note stands for whoever reuses those pins (BloodTestTimeline.cells-pins.test.tsx).
